subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Must the established ACP `streamLogPath` result remain compatible, or may this PR replace it with a different supported diagnostics handle in the same release?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes a documented tool-result field while moving its data behind an internal table; choosing the permanent public diagnostics contract requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Preserve a supported handle
options.body: Retain the existing field during a deprecation window or return a stable SQLite-backed query or export handle, then update documentation and compatibility tests.

options.title: Approve a breaking replacement
options.body: Explicitly accept removal, document the upgrade break, expose the replacement query surface, and update every caller and user-facing instruction before merge.

options.title: Defer the ACP journal move
options.body: Land the audit and memory migrations separately while keeping ACP relay diagnostics on the current path until the replacement contract is ready.

recommendation.title: Preserve a supported handle
recommendation.body: Retain the existing field during a deprecation window or return a stable SQLite-backed query or export handle, then update documentation and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for the current ACP parent-stream behavior and observable diagnostics contract.
